what_this_proves: The built native application no longer stops at 'verified on disk'. The device packages it (portable zip, or MSIX through makeappx with the Cloud Core's scaffolded manifest, never signed), installs it as a Start Menu shortcut it can observe, uninstalls exactly that, and streams the artefact back in hash-verified chunks so the owner can download a device build from a Cloud Core that cannot see the device's disk. The Cloud Core launches the application through the device, drives the template's own controls through UI Automation, closes and relaunches it, reads the note count and the application's own log, and says 'verified' only when every read-back answered; fixes by regenerating and rebuilding on the device and reports the compiler's words otherwise; updates into a new version row; and speaks a signing policy that is explicit about being unsigned.

closed_fully.466_log: read_log_on_device: file.read <exe dir>\data\app.log (8000 chars); native.log speaks line count and last line, keeps log_tail, names a missing log.
closed_fully.468_install: NativeLifecycle.Install: exe must be inside the project folder (Denied otherwise), Start Menu shortcut Programs\PagentOS\<name>.lnk (or PAGENTOS_NATIVE_PROGRAMS_DIR in the lab) through IShellLinkW/IPersistFile on an STA thread, installed.json under the native root {project_id, slug, name, exe, shortcut, sha256, installed_at}; result observed{shortcut_exists, exe_exists}; install_on_device verified only by observed.shortcut_exists; native.install refuses an unsigned MSIX row with the signing policy's sentence (owner_action 472).

closed_fully.470_fix: native.fix with a device: attempt+1, regenerate + build_on_device on the same row; verified → 'Düzelttim efendim: kaynağı yeniden üretip cihazda yeniden derledim'; otherwise refused 'Düzeltemedim efendim: …' with the row's error_class and the device's message, fixed:false; nothing broken → NOOP as before; no device → the old refusal.
closed_fully.471_update: native.update: plan_build(spec at _next_version, on_device=True) → new row → _build_on_device → install_on_device; receipt carries previous_build_id; old row untouched.
closed_fully.472_policy: app.nativefactory.signing: SigningPolicy(mode).implemented/signs/speech_for(kind)/as_dict; policy_from_settings(settings.native_signing_mode, default unsigned, unknown → unsigned); SPEECH_UNSIGNED_PORTABLE / SPEECH_UNSIGNED_MSIX / SPEECH_SIGNING_NOT_DECIDED; step_up tiers native.verify/log/update SENSITIVE, native.uninstall CRITICAL; session tool list carries the four new tools.
closed_fully.router: Intent.NATIVE_LAUNCH/VERIFY/LOG/UNINSTALL/UPDATE + CAPABILITY_BY_INTENT; matchers gated on native_build_focused (uninstall also on the installer noun), placed before check/fix/rebuild; the launch needs a native qualifier (_NATIVE_LAUNCH_QUALIFIER_STEMS: masaüstü/windows/exe/yerel/derle/native/program) so the bare 'uygulamayı aç' stays M23's; _NATIVE_LIFECYCLE_FOREIGN_STEMS = the foreign list without 'uygulam'/'proje'; 'günlü' stem for günlüğünü.

partial.473_test_certificate: The policy recognises test_certificate and owner_certificate and refuses them by name until the owner decides; no certificate is generated, stored or used (a certificate is a credential; only the secret store may hold it); signtool stays in NativeCapabilityNames.ForbiddenPrograms. READY_FOR_OWNER: choose self-signed test certificate / owner certificate / stay unsigned.

found_on_the_way.bare_sentence_contract: The first launch matcher took the bare 'Uygulamayı aç / çalıştır' while a native build was focused; the first full gate failed test_voice_native_intents (M28's contract: every other family keeps its own utterance even with a build in the system). The launch now needs a native word (masaüstü/Windows/exe/yerel/derlenen) or 'program'; corpus, unit tests and documents were rewritten to the qualified sentences.
found_on_the_way.owner_language: test_owner_error_language caught the artefact route answering the owner with the caught exception's text (f'{exc}') and, after the rewrite through log_and_detail, the class 'artifact_gone' no longer declared as a literal anywhere; the route now logs the exception, answers a Turkish sentence with details.reason, and declares ERROR_ARTIFACT_GONE as a module constant.
found_on_the_way.browser_worker_grace: The first full gate also lost BrowserWorkerHostTests.A_worker_that_stops_answering_pings_is_killed_and_replaced under load: the healthy REPLACEMENT worker was killed for three missed 100 ms pings while serving its first request (its own history records the same coin toss twice). BrowserWorkerHost now gives a worker that has never answered a ping a 2 s startup grace before missed pongs count (a worker that never answers is still killed after it; one that has answered loses the grace); the test asserts the kill's reason without the count. The second full gate lost the same test to the other half of the race: a request arriving right after the liveness kill was handed the DYING worker (Process.HasExited lags the kill under load) and failed with 'stdin is closed; it is being restarted' instead of starting the replacement; WorkerProcess.Alive is now false from the moment a kill is requested, so EnsureWorkerAsync settles the exit and spawns the replacement for that request.

red_first_proof.method: Executed mutations restored from sha256-verified copies (never git checkout); the C# mutation rebuilds the agent tests, runs the lab suite, then the restored tree is rebuilt.
mutations: M1 persistence no longer reads the note count after the relaunch -> 1 failure (test_nativefactory_lifecycle: persistence).
M2 an install the device did not observe (shortcut_exists) counts as done -> 1 failure.
M3 a portable/MSIX row is verified with the bare EXE and never packaged -> 2 failures (device_build msix + portable).
M4 the artefact route answers 410 without asking the device -> 1 failure (routes device pull).

M5 the native launch no longer needs a native build focused -> failures in test_without_a_native_build_the_same_words_stay_where_they_were ('Masaüstü uygulamasını aç' / 'EXE'yi aç' / 'Programı başlat' taken without a build); re-run red after the qualified-sentence rewrite.
M6 native.fix says 'Düzelttim' whatever the device's rebuild answered -> 1 failure.
M7 (C#) project.uninstall reports the shortcut removed without deleting it -> 1 failure in NativeLifecycleTests (8 run); restored tree rebuilt.
red_first_proof.result: 7/7 red; every file restored to its sha256 before the mutation

runtime_proof.status: PROVEN_REAL (device lab, this desktop): project.package zipped a real publish folder and reported its hash; project.install wrote a real Start Menu shortcut (Notlarım.lnk) through the shell and read it back, installed.json recorded it, project.uninstall removed it and the second removal was not_found; project.artifact streamed a real executable in 32 KiB chunks that reassembled to the reported sha256. Cloud flows proven against a scripted device that answers what the real device's own tests answer. The production round 26.16 (the built notes app installed, launched, verified through UI Automation, uninstalled on the owner's machine) is Karar 0's (READY_FOR_OWNER).
runtime_proof.why: REAL_PROOF_REQUIRED names 26.16 in production; no commit is made in this run by the owner's instruction, so no production round exists yet. The window-driving flow is the one the owner's qualification script proved by hand once (docs/QUALIFICATION.md row 26.15); this batch makes it code the device runs on command.
